name: Making Your Content AI-Friendly: Where to Start

step.name: Step 1: Identify Important Customer Questions and Entities: This is where we dive deep to uncover the actual questions people ask about your services, not just keywords. We look at Google Search Console, Q&A sites like Quora or Houzz, and more. This usually takes a few weeks to build a comprehensive list.
step.text: Step 1: Identify Important Customer Questions and Entities: This is where we dive deep to uncover the actual questions people ask about your services, not just keywords. We look at Google Search Console, Q&A sites like Quora or Houzz, and more. This usually takes a few weeks to build a comprehensive list.

step.name: Step 2: Create or Revise Focused Pages with Direct Answers: Once we know the questions, we help you craft content that provides straightforward, factual answers. This means ensuring important information is in crawlable text, using clear headings, and demonstrating expertise. This content generation phase can take several weeks, depending on the volume of questions.

step.name: Step 3: Improve Internal Linking and Maintain Business Information: We'll work on making sure your site's internal links guide AI crawlers efficiently and that your business details (name, address, services, hours) are consistent and accurate everywhere. This is an ongoing process but initial improvements can happen within a month.

step.name: Step 4: Validate Technical SEO and Structured Data: This involves ensuring your site's technical foundation is solid and that any structured data (schema) is correctly implemented and accurately describes your content. This validation is usually done concurrently with content updates and is a continuous check.

step.name: Step 5: Publish to an AI Resource Library: We take this optimized, answer-first content and publish it to dedicated AI-crawlable platforms like GitHub Pages. This process involves creating static HTML pages and rich JSON-LD schema, typically completed in iterations after content approval, with initial deployment within 1-2 months.
